title: Split 24 oversized modules to satisfy the 300-line gate
description: 24 source files exceed the 300-line modularity cap (up to backend/src/routes/assets.ts at 1647 and frontend/src/pages/assets/AssetDetailPage.tsx at 1546). The violations accumulated unseen because the smoke:qc drift step failed first for the whole build and aborted the gate before check:max-lines ever ran; drift is now acknowledged (.templateoverrides) and the max-lines failures are the sole smoke:qc blocker. Split each oversized file into cohesive modules (facade + submodules / extracted components) per the gate's own prescription, preserving behavior and public entry points.
notes: Resolved: all 24 files over the 300-line cap were split into cohesive modules with public import sites preserved via facades/barrels, per the gate's own prescription — no exemption list or threshold change. Backend routes (assets.ts 1647, imports.ts, services.ts) became thin Elysia facades composing per-concern submodule instances (routes/assets/{shared,core,mutations,hardware,networkInterfaces,storage,serviceAssignments,ports}.ts, routes/imports/, routes/services/). Backend services (assetImportService, assetService, assetServiceAssignmentService, assetStorageAllocationService, assetNetworkInterfaceService, assetSummaryService, assetPortService, serviceCatalogQueries, globalSearchService, relationshipQueries, serviceCatalogService) became barrels re-exporting query/command/helper submodules under sibling dirs. The db/schema/services.ts + schema-pg/services.ts pair was split into serviceCatalog.ts (catalog + assignments), serviceTopology.ts (dependency edges + ports), and serviceRelations.ts (all Drizzle relations, imported one-directionally to avoid a circular-import evaluation hazard), fronted by a services.ts barrel so schema/index.ts is unchanged; both dirs mirror each other so check:schema-parity passes. Frontend AssetDetailPage.tsx (1546) split into a page shell plus AssetDetailPage/ section components/primitives/formatters; AssetFormDialog, PortDialog, HardwareProfileDialog, InfrastructureTab, ServiceDetailPage split into extracted field bodies/models/subcards; api/assets.ts became a barrel over api/assets/ sub-resource modules; routes.tsx became a composer over routes/{publicRoutes,appRoutes,settingsRoutes}.tsx. Verification: `bun run check:max-lines` reports zero violations and full `bun run smoke:qc` is green end-to-end (typecheck, lint, backend+frontend build, API type contract 198 endpoints, feature integration, schema parity, format; acknowledged template drift only). .templateoverrides was not modified.
spec:
1. Run `bun run check:max-lines` for the authoritative offender list (24 files at filing time; largest: backend/src/routes/assets.ts 1647, frontend/src/pages/assets/AssetDetailPage.tsx 1546, backend/src/services/assetImportService.ts 730, frontend/src/api/assets.ts 607, backend/src/services/assetService.ts 598).
2. Split each file over 300 lines into cohesive modules: route files into per-concern route submodules re-exported from a facade; services into query/command/helper submodules behind the existing service facade; large pages/dialogs into extracted section components and hooks; frontend/src/routes.tsx via route-group modules. Follow the patterns already used by the spernakit template (e.g. routes/settings/index.ts facade).
3. Behavior must not change: no API contract, route path, or UI behavior changes — pure structural extraction. Keep import sites working via facades so diffs stay reviewable.
4. Do NOT weaken the gate: no exemption lists, no threshold changes.
5. After each batch, run `bun run check:max-lines` until it reports zero violations, then `bun run smoke:qc` end-to-end green (drift is acknowledged via .templateoverrides; do not modify that file).
6. Verify `bun run supertest`-relevant unit/API behavior still passes where quick checks exist (typecheck + lint + targeted route smoke via curl or crawltest scenarios).
7. Commit in reviewable batches (e.g. per subsystem: assets routes/services, imports, catalog, frontend pages).
